Work only on a fresh verified restored clone of the synthetic version1 backup; preserve the original. Run supported current schema validation and normal startup under I2, record actual appended migrations and unchanged canonical immutable identities. If schema compatibility cannot be validated, fail safely with old package/data retained.

Do not label generic startup or backup verification a proven downgrade guard. A bounded explicit compatibility check/refusal may be a genuine source gap to review separately, without changing financial semantics.
cross_version_boundary.rollback: Safest supported rollback uses preserved version1 package plus its untouched version1 data/verified backup in a fresh inhibited restore. Never point old executable at a potentially migrated newer store and claim rollback safety.
